description:
Actor Han Jae-hee lives his life driven by a desire to gain recognition from his famous actor father.

On the very day he resolves to end his life, he ends up making a life-risking contract with a demon named Kissmoor (also known as K), who takes an interest in him.

Meanwhile, due to psychological reasons, Jae-hee struggles with intimacy. In order to film a bed scene, he practices with the demon—who has transformed into the appearance of his co-star, Yoo Sung-woo.

But because of a misunderstanding on Jae-hee’s part, he ends up getting involved with the "real" Yoo Sung-woo as well…

---
